meta.name: SciCal constants library
meta.source: NIST SRD 121; Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga, Rev. Mod. Phys. 97, 025002 (2025)
meta.verified_current: CODATA 2022 (NIST release 9.0, 9 May 2024) is the newest edition listed at pml.nist.gov/cuu/Reference/versioncon.shtml; checked 2026-10-28.
meta.note: Constants listed with no uncertainty are exact. Values are decimal strings; SciCal reads them as exact decimals. Changing an entry changes every calculation that uses it, so tests/test_constants.py pins the values: an update must be deliberate.

mathematical.title: Mathematical
mathematical.description: Defined by mathematics, not measured. Irrational numbers are shown to 50 digits.

physical.title: Physical
physical.description: Fundamental physical constants: the SI defining constants (exact) and measured CODATA 2022 values with their standard uncertainties.

chemical.title: Chemical
chemical.description: Constants used in chemistry and thermodynamics.

astronomical.title: Astronomical
astronomical.description: IAU definitions and nominal values (exact conventions) are kept apart from derived, measured-dependent quantities.

engineering.title: Engineering reference
engineering.description: Standard gravity, standard atmosphere and exact unit-conversion factors. No material properties: those depend on the material and conditions.

editions.IAU 2015 B3: Nominal solar and planetary conversion constants

c.name: speed of light in vacuum
c.description: Speed of light in vacuum. One of the seven SI defining constants; it defines the metre.
c.source: CODATA 2022 (NIST SRD 121; Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga, Rev. Mod. Phys. 97, 025002 (2025))
c.note: Exact by definition (an SI defining constant or an exact product of them).

h.name: Planck constant
h.description: Planck constant, relating a photon's energy to its frequency. An SI defining constant; it defines the kilogram.
h.source: CODATA 2022 (NIST SRD 121; Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga, Rev. Mod. Phys. 97, 025002 (2025))
h.note: Exact by definition (an SI defining constant or an exact product of them).
